messages.author: c2be02cf0a402f59
messages.subject: custom input binding for dynamic content
parts:
I'm trying to build dynamic input controls. It looks like this, https://rokka.shinyapps.io/testing-inputbox. code is here https://github.com/lukas-rokka/testing-inputbox

It works fine with inserting html with the insertUI, but I have hard time figuring out how to dynamically delete the content. My approach is to create an new remove button class and make it return the id of its parent, and then remove that with removeUI("#id").

I made this js binding definition (a copy/paste of the input_binding_actionbutton.js, but with a different getValue function): https://github.com/lukas-rokka/testing-inputbox/blob/master/www/custom-controls.js. For some reason my new binding does not work, in the browser console I get the error that the InputBinding js function has not been defined. Can't figure out why, something with the order of how scripts should be loaded?

Regards,
Lukas Lundström

messages.author: c2be02cf0a402f59
messages.subject: Re: custom input binding for dynamic content
parts:
Got it working by using action-buttons with unique id's and looping through the input[[]] list with an observer.

Still wold like to know what's wrong with my input binding definition though. Would like to have my own inputBox class that returns all input values (within the inputBox) as one object/list.

/Lukas
